title: 第十一章  是不是在哪里见过你
content_zh:
陈木刚刚跟着苏本来的时候便看到了别墅旁有个小屋子，也不知道干嘛用的，陈木用神识扫了一下，里面都是一些杂物，不过还是有一个木板床在里面。

    “你。。。”苏林依有些不知道说什么，陈木对她来说完全就是一个陌生人，也不知道自己的父亲为什么要安排一个陌生人到自己的别墅。

    “随便你。”说完，苏林依便气呼呼的进了别墅，如果是平常苏林依绝不可能让一个陌生男子进自己的别墅，哪怕是住在外面园丁的休息屋，但今天自己母亲醒了过来，而且这个家伙还给自己教训了一番王艺，所以苏林依想了想，反正不住在别墅里面，应该不会影响到自己。

    不过为了以防万一，苏林依还是拿出了手机，打给了孙依诗这个小妮子，这个小妮子的强悍苏林依是知道的，如果孙依诗跟自己住在一起，自己的安全感会更加足一些。

    “喂，小诗，陈木要住在我别墅里面了，而且还是住在外面的园丁休息室！如果让我爸知道，恐怕还会以为我虐待他，但是让他住在别墅里面有绝对不行，小诗，你说现在怎么办？”苏林依拨通了孙依诗的电话，将自己的困扰说给了孙依诗听，想让这个小妮子给自己出出主意。

    “那不是挺好的，你别墅里面的花花草草你不是最喜欢鼓弄吗，现在有人替你照顾，那还不是好事，我还记得上次你的一个红色小花朵死了，你伤心了半天。”孙依诗刚洗完澡，舒舒服服的躺在一张欧式大床上看电视，让人有些喷血的是，孙依诗竟然只穿了一件透明白色睡衣，姣好的身材充满了诱惑，如果现在有男人跑进来，哪怕看一眼，抑制力不好的，绝对要大出血！

    “小诗！你到底出不出主意，主要的问题是我种的那些花草吗？是有个陌生男人住进了我的别墅！”苏林依见孙依诗不痛不痒的话，简直气炸了，这个小妮子平时鬼主意最多，今天怎么这么敷衍！

    “我觉得挺好的啊，好啦，依依姐，你不要这么防着陈木，我看他挺老实的，应该不会对你做什么的，比如偷看你洗澡，我相信陈木是绝对不会做的。。。”

    苏林依见孙依诗的话越说越不靠谱，顿时一阵气恼，让你出主意，是让你夸陈木的吗？

    “停！孙依诗，你现在到我别墅来，立刻、马上！”苏林依实在受不了孙依诗的念叨，直接放下狠话。

    “啊，依依姐，我现在什么都没穿，你让我穿上衣服，我马上过去。”孙依诗见到苏林依真的生气了，立刻闭上了嘴巴

    “我数到十，再看不到你，立刻绝交！”苏林依知道这小妮子不威胁一下，恐怕一直都不会妥协，苏林依从小认识孙依诗到大，这小妮子什么人，她一清二楚。
content_en:
When Chen Mu just followed Su Benn, he saw a small room next to the villa. He didn't know what it was for. Chen Mu scanned it with his spiritual consciousness. It was full of debris, but there was still a wooden bed inside.

"You..." Su Linyi didn't know what to say. Chen Mu was a complete stranger to her, and she didn't know why her father would arrange for a stranger to come to her villa.

"Whatever you want." After saying that, Su Linyi angrily entered the villa. If it were normal, Su Linyi would never let a strange man enter his villa, even if he lived in the gardener's rest house outside. But today his mother woke up, and this guy also taught himself a lesson in Wang Yi, so Su Linyi thought about it. Anyway, if he doesn't live in the villa, it shouldn't affect him.

But just in case, Su Linyi took out his mobile phone and called Sun Yishi, a little girl. Su Linyi knew how tough this little girl was. If Sun Yishi lived with him, he would feel more secure.

"Hey, Xiaoshi, Chen Mu is going to live in my villa, and he's still living in the gardener's lounge outside! If my dad knows, I'm afraid he will think that I'm abusing him, but it's absolutely not okay to let him live in the villa. Xiaoshi, what do you think we should do now?" Su Linyi dialed Sun Yishi's number and told Sun Yishi about her troubles, hoping that this little girl would give her some advice.

"Isn't that great? Don't you like playing with the flowers and plants in your villa the most? Now that someone is taking care of them for you, that's not a good thing. I still remember the last time one of your little red flowers died, and you were sad for a long time." Sun Yishi had just finished taking a bath, feeling comfortable.Lying on a European-style bed watching TV, what makes people bleed is that Sun Yishi is only wearing a transparent white pajamas. Her beautiful figure is full of temptation. If a man comes in now, even if he takes a look, he will definitely bleed if he has poor restraint!

"Xiao Shi! Can you come up with any ideas? Is the main problem the flowers and plants I planted? A strange man moved into my villa!" Su Linyi was furious when she saw Sun Yishi's indifferent words. This little girl usually has the most clever ideas, why was she so perfunctory today!

"I think it's pretty good. Okay, Sister Yiyi, don't be so defensive about Chen Mu. I think he is quite honest and won't do anything to you, such as peeking at you taking a shower. I believe Chen Mu will never do that..."

Seeing that Sun Yishi's words were getting more and more unreliable, Su Linyi suddenly became angry. Did you ask you to come up with the idea to praise Chen Mu?

"Stop! Sun Yishi, come to my villa now, immediately!" Su Linyi couldn't stand Sun Yishi's nagging, so she directly put down her harsh words.

"Ah, Sister Yiyi, I'm not wearing anything right now. Let me put on some clothes and I'll be there right away." Sun Yishi saw that Su Linyi was really angry and immediately closed her mouth.

"I'll count to ten. If I don't see you again, I'll break off our relationship immediately!" Su Linyi knew that this little girl would never compromise if she didn't threaten her. Su Linyi had known Sun Yishi since she was a child, and she knew exactly who this little girl was.
title_en: Chapter 11 Have I seen you somewhere?
